## Functional assignment

The sequence is most consistent with a **phosphatidylserine decarboxylase** (EC **4.1.1.65**), an enzyme in phospholipid metabolism.

**Reaction:**

\[
\text{1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine} + \mathrm{H^+}
\rightarrow
\text{1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine} + \mathrm{CO_2}
\]

In short, it removes the carboxyl group from phosphatidylserine to produce phosphatidylethanolamine.

**Evidence:** The sequence has strong similarity to reviewed Arabidopsis phosphatidylserine decarboxylases (68–74% identity, with broad sequence coverage) and contains the characteristic PS_Dcarbxylase domain. Reference annotations report a covalently bound **pyruvoyl group** per subunit, generated through proenzyme autoprocessing.

This is a strong homology-supported assignment; the exact query protein’s activity has not been directly assayed in the evidence reviewed.
